scope: Numerical implementation and analytical profiles only; not calibrated forecast accuracy, operational truth isolation or product integration.
implemented: Explicit immutable estimator parameters and continuous planned motion intervals
Acceleration, rolling, air and grade work with declared conversion efficiencies
Battery-side equipment consumption, regeneration and discharge-power bounds
Full/empty estimated battery bounds with rejected recovery and unserved demand recorded
Earlier energy shortfall remains infeasible despite later recovery
Configurable midpoint step and prechecked work budget
Finite-input/output guards and versioned source/input evidence
numerical_refinement_test: Independent closed-form kinetic/cubic-drag integral; 0.4/0.2/0.1-second midpoint refinement errors reduce with expected second-order behavior. This is not complete SUMO mission convergence.

phase_1_compatibility.changes_to_preexisting_code: Only offline check scope, input fingerprint collection and development-image packaging; new energy files are not imported by the monitoring runtime.

isolation: Pure numerical function has no simulator/store/transport/file/network import. OS/network isolation of a deployed forecasting service remains untested and is not claimed.
remaining: Observation-based baseline and route/mission input preparation
Input freshness/missing/validity and qualified operating domain
Whole-mission training/validation/held-out partitions and independent runtime access-denial tests
Calibration, uncertainty method and D-18 threshold freeze before held-out evaluation
Unseen mission accuracy/coverage report and comparison against simple baselines
Versioned forecast records, API/dashboard integration and final P2-01 through P2-06 review
decision_D18: Still open; numerical tolerances are not physical forecast accuracy targets.
publications: Local Git only; no publication, commands or Phase 3.
